cases.question: Compare the City and West End prime rent observations in Q1 and Q2. Can the time denominator be established and can an annual rent trend be published?

evidence.text: Prime West End rents reached £175 per sq ft, up 6.1% y-o-y. Prime rents in the City also increased 8.8%, to £92.50 per sq ft.
Prime West End rents reached £180 per sq ft, up 5.9% y-o-y. Prime rents in the City increased at a greater rate of 8.6%, to £95 per sq ft.

cases.question: Explain Central London overall vacancy in Q1 and Q2, and distinguish Q2 West End overall vacancy, Grade A vacancy, and availability volume. State limits of method comparability.

evidence.text: Central London office vacancy stood at 8.4% as of Q1 2026, falling below the five-year average of 10.6%.

Total availability standing at 22.8m sq ft at the close of the quarter. Overall vacancy across Central London remained broadly stable during Q2 2026, standing at 8.4% at the end of the quarter, a marginal reduction of 2 basis points from Q1. The West End continues to be the most constrained market across Central London, with overall vacancy edging down to 6.7%. Grade A vacancy standing at just 1.3%.

cases.question: Compare BNP Central London quarterly take-up in Q1 and Q2. Distinguish quarter values from H1, show rounded-value arithmetic, and explain the publisher's 26% quarter-on-quarter claim without silently reconciling it.

evidence.text: Central London office take-up reached 2.5m sq ft in Q1 2026. Take-up figures based on all deals over 1,000 sq ft.

Central London office take-up reached 3.0m sq ft in Q2 2026, bringing H1 levels to 5.5m sq ft. Take-up figures based on all deals over 1,000 sq ft. Occupier activity strengthened considerably across Central London during Q2 2026, with take-up reaching 3.0m sq ft, representing a 26.0% increase on the previous quarter.

cases.question: What does the GPE City Tower announcement establish about pre-letting, space under offer, total area, and future refurbishment? Do not present a combined area as signed pre-let space.

evidence.text: GPE has pre let the initial floor of fully managed office space at City Tower, EC2, with a further floor under offer, as demand continues ahead of completion in early 2027. The transactions total more than 4,300 sq ft. The latest phase will convert a further 38,000 sq ft of space.

cases.question: Summarise the Silk Street planning announcement and British Land's Finsbury Avenue leasing update. Distinguish approval, construction/completion, and under-offer from signed leases.

evidence.text: City of London Corporation approves major office scheme on Silk Street. The Planning and Transportation Committee approved plans for the redevelopment of 1 Silk Street. The office-led scheme includes approximately 86,000 sq m of Grade A office space.
Our campus developments continue to lease up at record rents, with 1 Broadgate and One Triton Square now fully let and a further 119,000 sq ft under offer at 2 Finsbury Avenue.

cases.question: BNP and JLL give different Central London Q2 take-up and vacancy observations. Can they be combined into one trend? Identify each publisher, value, period and the missing comparability evidence.

evidence.text: Central London office take-up reached 3.0m sq ft in Q2 2026. Central London office vacancy stood at 8.4% as of Q2 2026.
